observed_problem: The production-control adopt-stage operation executes exactly one deterministic action and commits its result, but when that transition reaches ARCHITECTURE_ESTABLISHED or RELEASE_CANDIDATE it does not persist the newly current HUMAN_GATE Action Spec. The approval operations search the committed orchestration/specs directory for that exact Human Gate spec and therefore have no canonical input to approve.
expected_behavior: A one-stage production adoption that lands on a pending Human Gate must persist the current terminal HUMAN_GATE Action Spec, without executing any additional deterministic stage, before committing the work branch. Approval workflows must then consume that exact State-bound spec.
actual_behavior: After the Architecture stage or Publication Candidate stage, execute-current returns with the transitioned State but only the executed stage spec/result exists. A second unmodeled local planning/commit step is required before approve-architecture or approve-publication-preview can succeed, so the canonical workflow path is incomplete.
production_workaround: External W33/SP001 production remains blocked until the coherent Core v2 candidate is Human-reviewed and merged; canonical adoption now persists the terminal Human/Exception/Complete Action Spec without executing an extra deterministic stage.
improvement_action: Make execute-current persist a second, non-executed terminal Action Spec when the one adopted action transitions onto a Human/Exception/Complete terminal plan; expose the persisted terminal spec path in its result and add a regression proving one deterministic action reaches a Human Gate with both the stage result and exact terminal spec committed while drafting remains unexecuted.
